content.markdown: True when the Macro accepts an unfixed number of children. Its default and named Styles may expand children with `#*` or omit `#*` and every positional placeholder to display only a literal/name. In the latter case supplied arguments are ignored for display but remain in the semantic tree. The same rule applies to invariant and localized template projections; all projections within one Style retain a consistent placeholder contract. Dynamic Styles cannot use fixed positional placeholders; fixed macros cannot use `#*`. This is one Macro-level arity contract, not a per-Style arity setting.
